verdict.rationale: Extend ships an official MCP server and an Agent Quickstart for connecting a chat or tool-calling client, so users can drive Extend's operations through natural language in an external AI client. The evidence shows no native natural-language command interface inside Extend itself, and the 'Composer' agent is only named on the pricing page, with no description of what it does. missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface, details on what Composer does, a hands-on or independent account of natural-language operation, and documentation of which operations can be invoked conversationally.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
